## Body

Shipping a new template version (plan 210 added v3 of the six core templates):
1. Copy `templates/roles/<name>/v<N>/role.dd.json` to `v<N+1>/`. Change only what the version is for, set `meta.template_version`, and append one changelog row that says exactly what changed (pm v3 changed a rule as well as the wording, so its row says so).
2. `crates/daemon/src/community/templates.rs`: add `("<name>", N+1)` to `SHIPPED` and a sha256 row to `PINNED` in `a_shipped_version_is_never_edited`, and bump both array lengths. Run `biome check` on the file before you hash it.
3. `crates/daemon/tests/templates_http/mod.rs` asserts coder's version list; update it.
4. Tests: `templates_http` is a module of the `directory_http` target, so run it with `cargo test -p pij-daemon --test directory_http templates`. Also run `--lib community::templates` and `-p pij-cli --test skill_verb_coverage`, through `just shared-build`.
5. Check v2 against v3 with a field-by-field JSON diff, not a text diff.

ddocs facts from the pij/workstream schema:
- A single link field works (`"type": "link"` without an array).
- A link into a doc of another schema fails E406 ("link targets pij/roadmap/section/steps, expected pij/workstream/...").
- There is still no cross-row rule, so "umbrella complete only when children are" needs a sensor.
- Schema fixtures under `.dd/schemas/pij/*/fixtures` are checked by hand only; no test runs them.
- `cargo fmt -p <crate> --check`, not bare rustfmt: the workspace edition orders imports differently.
